sources.title: ALINA updated results; Dziadziuszko et al, ESMO 2025 1787MO
relevant_pages: 5: stage II–IIIA and ITT DFS at 48 months
7–9: CNS DFS, OS and subsequent therapy
sources.notes: Primary investigator presentation visually inspected at slide 5. Stage II–IIIA 74.5% versus 46.3%; ITT75.5% versus 47.0%. Abstract reverses arm-specific median follow-up relative to slide: display omits that disputed follow-up while keeping identical cutoff/endpoint figures.

sources.title: ALINA primary analysis: resected ALK-positive NSCLC, 2024
sources.retrieval_method: Fresh web search and primary publication/abstract inspection
sources.notes: NEJM2024 primary ALINA publication. Completely resected AJCC/UICC7 stageIB≥4 cm–IIIA; DFS from randomisation; primary analysis cutoff 26 June 2023. Updated 2025 conference analysis retained separately.

sources.title: ALINA updated DFS, ESMO 2025 abstract 1787MO; cutoff 8 December 2024
sources.retrieval_method: Fresh web search and primary publication/abstract inspection
sources.notes: Annals of Oncology abstract 1787 MO; DOI10.1016/j.annonc.2025.08.2413. Efficacy cutoff 8 December 2024; OS immature; quantitative values cross-checked against author slides.

sources.title: ALEX final OS analysis, 2025; cutoff 28 April 2025
sources.retrieval_method: Fresh web search and primary publication/abstract inspection
sources.notes: Peters et al final ALEX OS, Annals of Oncology 2025, PMID41110693. Cutoff 28 April 2025; medianOS81.1 vs 54.2 months, HR0.78 CI0.56–1.08. CI includes 1; no claim of statistically significant OS advantage.

sources.title: Ou et al: post-crizotinib single-arm phase II global study
sources.retrieval_method: Fresh web search and primary publication/abstract inspection
sources.notes: Ou et al global phaseII, JCO2016 PMID26598747; 138 treated,122 response-evaluable, ORR50%, medianPFS8.9 months. Single arm, no comparative survival claim.

visual_checks.result: Verified ≥30 renal boundary, >5/≤2 liver row, >3/>2 combined row and bradycardia continuation.
Verified grade4 cause/recurrence branches, strict CPK>5/>10, haemoglobin<10, oral risk and no premedication.
Current SmPC dose rows visually agree with NCCP.
Current SmPC CPK, bradycardia, haemolysis and organ statements agree.
Separate stageII–IIIA and ITT DFS values and cutoff verified.
Minimal–low oral support is as required only.

conflicts.details: NCCP says ECG prior to cycle 2 but treatment is continuous with no cycle duration; no 28-day or other interval is invented. Local timing confirmation is displayed.
Abstract assigns 47 and 48 months to alectinib/chemotherapy; investigator slide assigns 48.0 and 47.4 months. These arm-specific follow-up values are not displayed in the authored endpoint cards.
NCCP 00401c table says N/A. That is retained as a printed source entry; current access requires separate verification. EU licence and NCCP inclusion are not payment approval.
NCCP/SmPC dose table says CTCAE without specifying edition. Source-specific descriptions retained without a false CTCAE5 declaration.
